note: Attacker-controlled CRL bag bytes from the PKCS#12 input are extracted into the datum 'data' inside the certificate/CRL scanning loop.
The malformed CRL bytes are handed to the CRL parser; strict DER decoding of the garbage fails and ret becomes negative.
On CRL import failure the freshly initialized CRL object is deinitialized, but *crl is NOT reset to NULL afterwards, leaving a dangling pointer for the shared cleanup path.
The 'done' cleanup re-checks *crl; because it was not nulled after the first deinit, the dangling pointer satisfies the non-NULL guard.
Second deinitialization of the already-freed CRL object: double-free / use-after-free triggered during cleanup.
